notes.title: An Egg Can Dream - Available Now!
notes.content:
The game is now available for $9.99 USD but is 10% off for the first week of sale!

We hope you enjoy the game, but try not to rage quit too quickly.

If you have any questions feel free to ask us anytime in the game's discussions/forums or alternatively reach out to us on Twitter [url=https://www.twitter.com/TheFloorChicken]@TheFloorChicken[/url]

notes.title: An Egg Can Dream Release Party!
notes.content:
On May 20th we will be releasing An Egg Can Dream for all to enjoy.

The release time is approximately 00:00am (midnight) EST.

In the meantime if you have any questions feel free to ask us anytime in the game's discussions/forums or alternatively reach out to us on Twitter [url=https://www.twitter.com/TheFloorChicken]@TheFloorChicken[/url]
